hero.headline: Mostly Harmless.
hero.summary: I make games, build little worlds, and turn curious ideas into playful experiences. From 3D and mobile to VR & AR, there’s always something new brewing at my desk.
hero.note: A few games. A lot of curiosity.

about.title: Little about me
paragraphs: I have spent 8 years in the game dev trenches building 3D, VR/AR, and mobile experiences.  I just really love turning cool ideas into playable reality, whether I'm building solo or collaborating with a team. My portfolio is a pretty fun mix of everything I've broken and fixed along the way.
When I'm away from the screen, you'll usually find me lost in a good book with a warm cup of coffee, or out for a walk soaking in a podcast or audiobook.
